sentences.en: In fact, the inhabitants have been exposed to radioactive rays.
sentences.zh: 事实上，居民们已经暴露在放射性射线下。

sentences.en: In this country, most of the inhabitants are Sunni Muslims.
sentences.zh: 在这个国家，大多数居民是逊尼派穆斯林。

sentences.en: The inhabitants of the Gizeldon Valley are used to avalanches.
sentences.zh: 吉泽登山谷的居民习惯于雪崩的发生。

senses.zh: 居民，住户,（栖息在某地区的）动物
